item.title: AI News, Wednesday October 14
item.description:
Wednesday October 14: Netflix Eyeline hybrid AI production, Kang's 40% budget claim and Weta's color limits, Kling 4.0's October rollout, a Kling/Veo/Seedance shootout, Apple's Remnants on Vision Pro, Magnific One and ElevenLabs Brand Kits, Nano Banana 2.1 on Higgsfield, and macOS 27 for FCP shops.

  1. How AI is used at Netflix Eyeline Studios – Mousavi at View Conference on hybrid production, sparse sets, and the last 30–40% to broadcast quality
  2. Netflix AI on ~300 titles; Kang cites up to 40% budget savings – Busan panel with Weta's Thurston on assistive AI and color-volume limits ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/10/netflix-ai-weta-fx-kimball-thurston-run-to-the-west-1237153889/))
  3. Kling 4.0 early access and October rollout – 30s clips, 10 keyframes, Omni Reference; PROMPTR music-video case study ([VOZMI](https://vozmi.app/blog/kling-4-0-viral-ai-music-video))
  4. Kling 4.0 vs Veo 3.1 vs Seedance 2.5 – pick by job: keyframes vs references vs short cinematic shots
  5. Remnants immersive horror on Vision Pro – Ti West, Oct 16 exclusive; 8K 180° Spatial Audio ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/12/apple-unveils-immersive-horror-film-coming-to-vision-pro-this-week/))
  6. Magnific One launches with Brand Kit – art-direction layer on GPT Image 2; draft then final to 4K
  7. ElevenLabs Brand Kit in ElevenCreative – reusable visual identity tagged into Image & Video, Flows, and agent
  8. Nano Banana 2.1 on Higgsfield – up to 4K, 14 references; plus Katana Claude skill ([Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/google-launches-nano-banana-2-1-3719823/))
  9. macOS 27 Golden Gate for video editors – FCP 12.4 Cinematic mode needs Golden Gate; Adobe ok, Avid not qualified

item.title: AI News, Tuesday October 13
item.description:
Tuesday October 13: an AI-made Christmas feature on Seedance, Nano Banana and ElevenLabs, new crew roles from Busan, Banderas in an AI epic, a possible Sora comeback, a physics benchmark, previs in code, and Meta's first frontier model.

  1. Merry the Christmas Witch made for $1.5M instead of $80M – hybrid AI feature using ElevenLabs, Seedance and Nano Banana
  2. Kim Sung-soo on folding AI into his craft – Busan panel on hybrid drama and the new "AI coordinator" crew role
  3. Antonio Banderas to star in AI-powered Cortés – Utopai and Ex Machina Studios, in production in Paris
  4. OpenAI's Sora could get a second act – talks with a filmmaker-focused startup from Katzenberg and Bill Peebles
  5. Seedance 2.5 tops an AI video physics benchmark – 57.76 out of 100 across 40 measured physics tasks
  6. Microsoft's Code Video Model plans shots in code like previs – Three.js previs guides MiniMax H3
  7. Kandinsky 6.0 Video released open source – synced 44 kHz audio and video under MIT license
  8. Vivix W1 real-time interactive video – streaming-native model you can steer while it generates
  9. Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier model – comparable to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra in Meta's tests
  10. ElevenLabs launches Architect – assistant that diagnoses and fixes voice agents (and see [Eleven v4](https://elevenlabs.io/blog/eleven-v4))
  11. Bonus: Final Cut Pro release notes – 12.4 (Sept 29) is still the latest; FCP 13 not yet announced

item.title: AI News, Monday October 12
item.description:
Monday October 12: Netflix's AI use, video tools inside the chat window, Vidu Q4, an XPRIZE trailer heading for features, agent safety, and a Final Cut Pro 13 leak.

  1. Netflix has used AI on about 300 titles – Busan panel with Kang Yun-sung and Wētā FX (also see Variety: https://variety.com/2026/tv/festivals/netflix-ai-300-titles-kang-yoon-sung-40-percent-budget-busan-1236907359/)
  2. Higgsfield Katana runs inside Claude via MCP – conversational video editing powered by Claude Motion
  3. invideo Agentic Extend – extend scenes up to 30 seconds with picture, dialogue, music and SFX
  4. Voyager launches an AI harness for creative tools – drives Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut Pro and more
  5. Vidu Q4 Preview – 4K 10-bit, up to 15 image references
  6. ElevenLabs Brand Kit – reusable colors, fonts, logos and references in ElevenCreative
  7. Runway Solaris – an interface world model built on Gen-4.5
  8. AI trailer wins $2.5M XPRIZE, heads for ~$10M feature – backed by Google and Range Media
  9. Anthropic discloses unintended agent actions – and the White House says incident reporting is not optional (https://rainvent.ai/genai-daily-october-11-2026-anthropic-pulls-internet-from-evals-white-house-makes-incident-reporting-mandatory-firmus-scraps-5b-ipo/)
  10. UK AISI regains pre-release model testing – after a 17-day pause
  11. Bonus: Final Cut Pro 13 leaks – Pixelmator round-trip, Natural Motion Blur, keyframe easing
